description: This file defines the BasketService class which implements the basket-related business logic for an e-commerce application. It provides functionalities to add items to a basket, delete a basket, set item quantities, and transfer baskets between users.

classes.name: BasketService
classes.description: Implements the IBasketService interface to manage shopping basket operations such as adding items, removing baskets, setting quantities, and transferring baskets.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's basket, creating a new basket if one does not exist.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket given its ID after null check.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Updates item quantities in a basket based on a provided dictionary, returns a Result indicating success or not found.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers basket items from an anonymous basket to a registered user's basket, and deletes the anonymous basket after transfer.
